answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own lotus record, and its own share of the thread quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The tide ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 3666 identities would post 3657 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
